result.what_is_wrong: The measured Disparate Impact for age_group is 0.9791, which is a small deviation from parity (1.0) and above the moderate threshold specified in the audit.
result.why_is_wrong: The DI of 0.9791 stems from modest differences in selection rates and performance across age groups: selection_rate(mid)=0.7995, selection_rate(senior)=0.7433, selection_rate(young)=0.8372. Supporting fairness metrics are near parity (demographic_parity_diff = -0.0167, equal_opportunity_diff = -0.006, average_odds_diff = -0.0134) and theil_index = 0.296. TPRs (mid=0.9151, senior=0.8764, young=0.9488) and FPRs (mid=0.4947, senior=0.4712, young=0.4790) show only small differences, so the observed DI reflects minor selection-rate variation rather than large systematic exclusion.
result.how_to_fix: Apply Reweighing on the training data to adjust instance weights by age_group and outcome so that the weighted group-outcome distributions align more closely with parity; retrain the model on the reweighted data and re-evaluate DI and related metrics to confirm improvement.
